methodology.scope: National parliamentary-result estimates in active election_windows.json: election day 20:00 through the end of the following day (28 hours), Europe/Belgrade.

time_cutoffs.rule: Four cutoffs: election day 22:00, next day 00:00, next day 02:00, and midnight ending the next day. There is no 06:00 cutoff.
time_cutoffs.selection: Use the latest original full-list projection available at or before the cutoff, within the active collection interval. A post exactly at the final collection end is excluded. Composite charts become available only at the latest constituent post timestamp.
time_cutoffs.carry_forward: An earlier forecast remains the latest known forecast until updated; report its age and repeated selection. Reuse does not add independent evidence years.
time_cutoffs.missing: No eligible forecast is null, never a perfect forecast or zero error. Missing slots reduce year evidence weight.

methodology.comparison_rule: Compare accounts only in the same year and cutoff with available point metrics. Overall confidence depends on coverage and is not a ranking when slot/year coverage differs. matched_time_comparisons is alphabetical, not a leaderboard.
methodology.source_attribution: Only source_role=original_projection enters cutoff accuracy and confidence. Quotes, official results, incomplete vectors, bounds, winner and seat claims are retained separately. CeSID/Ipsos is one source family.
methodology.error: published share minus corresponding official share; MAE = mean absolute error, RMSE = sqrt(mean squared error); units percentage points (pp).
methodology.headline_party_set: Six largest lists by final vote count in each election, equal weight. All-list metrics also retained; small-list dilution is therefore visible.
methodology.denominator: 2020 CeSID valid ballots inferred from complete charts summing near 100; 2022/2023 CeSID ballots cast inferred from sums near 97. Alternative bases included.
methodology.geographic_scope: CRTA samples exclude Kosovo voters, prisons and abroad. The requested benchmark is final national totals, including reruns. Valid-vote normalization does not remove geographic mismatches; errors measure discrepancy from this national benchmark, not pure matched-population forecast error. Turnout is left unscored where a matching scope benchmark is unavailable.
methodology.confidence_error: Normalize the complete forecast vector and official counts to valid votes, calculate top-six MAE, then average equally over available fixed cutoff slots within each year. Extra intermediate updates do not receive extra weight. Normalization removes denominator assumptions from this score but does not assess invalid-ballot predictions.
methodology.bounds: Keep one-sided and two-sided statements as bounds. Measure containment and distance outside them; do not invent point estimates or call broad containment 100% forecasting accuracy.
methodology.E: Weighted mean of yearly equal-cutoff normalized top-six MAE. Only original complete-list point forecasts contribute.
methodology.N: Sum of year weights = (number of available cutoffs / 4) * collection multiplier. The multiplier is 1 for an exhausted current query/window, otherwise 0.75. Each year contributes at most 1 regardless of the number of posts or repeated cutoff selections.
methodology.model_change: Schema 2 replaces averaging all snapshots with fixed-cutoff averaging and coverage weighting. Bounds-only years no longer raise the point-forecast confidence score. Scores are not directly comparable with schema 1.
methodology.collection_rule: Only exhausted checkpoints with the current account query are used to cover the active window. Old partial narrower searches do not invalidate a completed wider search. Exhausted adjacent intervals can jointly cover the window.
methodology.confidence_interpretation: User-requested heuristic support score, not a calibrated probability, statistical confidence interval, general trust score, or percentage of correct posts. Constants are explicit judgment choices, not fitted to data.
methodology.no_evidence: Score 1 is a required-scale floor for no quantitative forecast evidence. Accuracy metrics are null; do not treat this floor as evidence the account is wrong.
methodology.seats: Minimum seats to reassign = sum(abs(projected-final))/2. Allocation agreement = 100*(1-distance/250). Separate from vote accuracy and confidence to avoid double counting.
methodology.supplementary: Turnout, invalid ballots, voter registration, threshold and winner statements are checked separately and do not increase numerical-forecast confidence.
methodology.exclusions: Separate presidential/local elections; turnout at 19:00; percentages of sample received; process/irregularity reports; linked videos/pages not present in saved data.

limitations: Only three historical election nights. Accounts with no saved forecasts are unassessed, not demonstrated inaccurate.

API exhaustion only covers the current account query/window; deleted posts and external linked content remain absent. Unavailable videos are audited but not transcribed or assumed to contain no numerical claims.
Missing cutoff data can reflect late publication or incomplete collection. Compare accounts only where year and cutoff match, and check collection coverage.
Full-list normalization cannot be applied to a few selected parties. Bounds and partial vectors do not receive a comparable point-forecast score.
Final official results include repeat voting and administrative corrections. Retrospective differences do not by themselves demonstrate a reporting mistake on election night.
CRTA sample exclusions differ from the national benchmark. Latest CRTA 2022 chart also contains an ambiguous literal 0 for the Russian minority list; it is preserved rather than silently corrected.
Updates on the same night are correlated. CeSID/Ipsos joint estimates form one source family, not two independent confirmations.
Forecasts are rounded, mainly to 0.1 pp. Sampling design is unavailable, so no statistical confidence interval or calibrated probability is claimed.
Final official counts are the requested benchmark; this does not assess electoral integrity or resolve reported irregularities.
The fixed confidence weights and 2 pp scale express a conservative screening rule. Use underlying errors and evidence counts for decisions, not score alone.
